title: fix: keep mobile latest button clear of activity pills
body:
Closes #179017

## What Problem This Solves

In mobile chat, Scroll to latest can obscure an activity pill. With an expanded multiline draft, tapping it can also collapse the composer and move the button before its click activates.

## User Impact

The button rises only when a pill intersects its centered position. It stays in its usual position with no pills or a short left-only pill, and remains usable while editing a multiline draft.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing transcript geometry owner now consumes activity-strip resize/scroll notifications and reuses cached pill bounds during ordinary transcript updates. The same owner publishes the needed clearance. The actual latest button also participates in the existing mobile composer interaction boundary, preventing premature collapse on pointerdown.

## Evidence

The original bundled UI failed the overlap assertion at 360 and 430 px. An original-source pointer trace also reproduced the expanded-composer missed click. The repaired 360 px geometry/tap case passed; the final 430 px case passed all three pill states, removal/restoration, and real taps with an eight-line draft at 430 × 560. Final 430 case: 4.418 seconds; Vitest total: 13.04 seconds. The 360 case was intentionally filtered from that final interaction replay; its geometry inputs did not change.

Existing activity tests passed 4/4; existing mobile composer tests passed 2/2 (3.00 seconds wall). UI/E2E types, changed interaction lint, E2E lint, stylelint, controller guards, formatting, and diff checks passed.

[Independent Codex review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179021#issuecomment-6308258864) completed with no actionable P0–P2 findings.

**Risk and coverage:** Full changed-production lint retains the baseline-identical 701/700 active-line failure in `chat-transcript-virtualizer-host.ts`; this change adds no lines there and does not change the limit. Existing composer fixtures emit nonfatal strict-read warnings. Browser proof uses the real bundled UI and a synthetic Gateway; physical-device keyboard behavior and performance benchmarks were not measured. CI timing is pending.

Both captures use 430 × 844 and the same fixture. The final transcript rests 18 px higher; button, pill, and composer coordinates are directly comparable. The final button has a 12 px gap above the pill.

### Prior-head CI attribution
Exact-head run [39545817507](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39545817507), attempt 1, failed five cases across three UI E2E jobs. The two mobile Sharing Loading selectors, empty Groups visibility fixture, and sidebar plus main-session fixture were repaired separately by commit `687fcdcc99f7b2e8b5448fac6fbdf80bcdb828fb` in #178964. The Solo-widget second `board.update` timeout has the exact matching signature on scheduled main run [39550194897](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39550194897/job/119057783773); its underlying cause remains unresolved.

The inspected CI checkout `ae8b94e6263b1924b7b524069803722207dcc773` has the recorded main baseline and this exact PR head as ordered parents, and its tree matches their recomputed merge. All eleven inspected failure-specific source inputs are identical between the baseline and tested merge. These are inherited failures, not green CI. The existing scoped browser and interaction proof above remains the validation for this change.


### Required security publisher refresh
The previous Security Review publication used an older workflow blob than the current protected workflow. Main `55fca0edc2ee36d85dda86c49cb45e86bcbae61f` was integrated without conflicts to obtain current publisher validation. The twelve-file product patch is identical (stable patch ID `485aaba58b2e4c6dd01ffed9f64fb6a9167b08fd`). Existing visual and focused behavior proof is retained; prior failed CI attribution is historical, and current-head CI is pending.


### Current-head CI attribution
Run [39561664419](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39561664419), attempt 1, finished all 62 jobs. The only non-aggregate failure is the existing dashboard-layout test waiting for the old header **Chat** button. Commit `f9376e14a2b0c2ebf4b8ccf37643dc6183e287a0` (#179094) intentionally removed that duplicate control in favor of **Panels** before this run’s main baseline. The test still selects the removed button at `chat-panel-layout.e2e.test.ts:207`.

The actual tested merge `903b7678b791b964f53e5baa5f0e40824d5016d0` contains baseline `55fca0ed` and current PR head `ebccf100`; five relevant test/header/panel-owner blobs are identical between baseline and tested merge. Security-fast passed. This is an attributed inherited failure, not green CI. The stale test is being repaired separately in the related Details/Dashboard work while preserving both drafts and independent Details behavior.
